svg.title: From a traditional web app to a connector-native MCP app
svg.desc: Two stacks side by side. Traditional web app: a person, your website or mobile app, your REST API, business logic, your database; you build every layer. Connector-native MCP app: a person, Claude, ChatGPT or another AI client (provided, it understands the request and calls tools), your MCP tools, resources and MCP Apps screens, business logic scoped to one company, and a system of record in Neon Postgres with pgvector. You build the bottom three layers; the AI client replaces the website and the chat.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Build the capabilities, not the whole experience

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The AI client the user already works in takes over the screens, the conversation and the planning. You build what the business needs.
